rules: Corporate identity, solutions and services content belong on www.skunkworksau.com.au.
Product discovery, licensing and checkout belong on store.skunkworksau.com.au.
Training catalogues, labs, credentials, and learner services belong on www.skunkworksacademy.com.
Skunkworks Africa ecosystem content belongs on www.skunkworks.africa.
Every indexable page must emit a self-referencing canonical URL.
Navigation order is Solutions, Services, Store, Academy, Company, Contact.
Mobile navigation must expose the same primary destinations as desktop navigation.
